Name: Used To The Weight
Description: Wearing a shield does not slow you down as much.
Details: Reduces movement speed penalty by up to half.

Name: Blast-Born
Description: Your hearing is less affected by nearby explosions.

Name: Gentle Pressure
Description: You make less noise when breaching.
Details: Each upgrade reduces breaching noise range.

Name: Fight Or Flight
Description: When hurt in combat, regain stamina.
Details: Recover stamina after being hit by another player.

Name: Proficient Pryer
Description: Breaching doors and containers takes less time.

Name: Survivor's Stamina
Description: When critically hurt, stamina regenerates faster.
Details: Improves stamina recovery while badly hurt.
Requires: Fight Or Flight and 15 points in Conditioning

Name: Unburdened Roll
Description: If your shield breaks, your first dodge roll soon after costs no stamina.
Requires: Proficient Pryer and 15 points in Conditioning

Name: Downed But Determined
Description: When downed, it takes longer before you collapse.

Name: A Little Extra
Description: Breaching an object generates resources.

Name: Effortless Swing
Description: Melee abilities cost less stamina.
Details: Allows more melee swings before stamina runs out.

Name: Turtle Crawl
Description: While downed, you take less damage.

Name: Loaded Arms
Description: Your equipped weapon has less impact on encumbrance.

Name: Sky-Clearing Swing
Description: You deal more melee damage to drones.

Name: Back On Your Feet
Description: When critically hurt, your health regenerates up to a limit.
Requires: Turtle Crawl or Loaded Arms and 36 points in Conditioning

Name: Flyswatter
Description: Wasps and Turrets can be destroyed with one melee attack.
Details: Improves melee utility against small ARC threats.
Requires: Loaded Arms or Sky-Clearing Swing and 36 points in Conditioning

Name: Nimble Climber
Description: You can climb and vault more quickly.

Name: Marathon Runner
Description: Moving around costs less stamina.

Name: Slip and Slide
Description: You can slide further and faster.

Name: Youthful Lungs
Description: Increases maximum stamina.

Name: Sturdy Ankles
Description: You take less fall damage from non-lethal falls.

Name: Carry The Momentum
Description: After a sprint dodge roll, sprinting briefly costs no stamina.
Requires: Youthful Lungs and 15 points in Mobility

Name: Calming Stroll
Description: While walking, stamina regenerates as if standing still.
Requires: Sturdy Ankles and 15 points in Mobility

Name: Effortless Roll
Description: Dodge rolls cost less stamina.

Name: Crawl Before You Walk
Description: When downed, you crawl faster.
Requires: Carry The Momentum or Calming Stroll

Name: Off The Wall
Description: You can wall leap further.

Name: Heroic Leap
Description: You can sprint dodge roll further.

Name: Vigorous Vaulter
Description: Vaulting is no longer slowed while exhausted.
Details: Improves vaulting while out of stamina.

Name: Ready To Roll
Description: When falling, the recovery roll timing window is increased.

Name: Vaults on Vaults on Vaults
Description: Vaulting no longer costs stamina.
Requires: Heroic Leap or Vigorous Vaulter and 36 points in Mobility

Name: Vault Spring
Description: Lets you jump at the end of a vault.
Details: Adds extra movement options after vaulting.
Requires: Vigorous Vaulter or Ready To Roll and 36 points in Mobility

Name: Agile Croucher
Description: Your movement speed while crouching is increased.

Name: Looter's Instincts
Description: When searching a container, loot is revealed faster.

Name: Revitalizing Squat
Description: Stamina regeneration while crouched is increased.

Name: Silent Scavenger
Description: You make less noise when looting.

Name: In-round Crafting
Description: Unlocks the ability to field-craft items while topside.

Name: Suffer In Silence
Description: While critically hurt, your movement makes less noise.
Requires: Silent Scavenger and 15 points in Survival

Name: Good As New
Description: While under a healing effect, stamina regeneration is increased.
Requires: In-round Crafting and 15 points in Survival

Name: Broad Shoulders
Description: Increases the maximum weight you can carry.
Details: Adds carry capacity for loot-heavy runs.

Name: Traveling Tinkerer
Description: Unlocks additional items to field craft.
Details: Adds more crafting options during runs.
Requires: Suffer In Silence or Good As New

Name: Stubborn Mule
Description: Stamina regeneration is less affected by over-encumbrance.

Name: Looter's Luck
Description: While looting, there is a chance to reveal twice as many items at once.

Name: One Raider's Scraps
Description: When looting Raider containers, there is a chance of finding additional field-crafted items.

Name: Three Deep Breaths
Description: After an ability drains stamina, you recover more quickly.

Name: Security Breach
Description: Lets you breach Security Lockers.
Requires: Looter's Luck or One Raider's Scraps and 36 points in Survival

Name: Minesweeper
Description: Mines and explosive deployables can be defused nearby.
Requires: One Raider's Scraps or Three Deep Breaths and 36 points in Survival
